goals: Verify that the calculator correctly calculates the sum of two positive numbers across multiple input combinations (20+30=50, 2+5=7, 0+40=40, 4+50=54, 5+50=55)
Verify that the calculator correctly calculates the sum of two negative numbers (-1 + -3 = -4)
activities: Enter 20 and 30 into calculator; press add; verify result is 50
Enter 2 and 5; press add; verify result is 7
Enter 0 and 40; press add; verify result is 40
Enter 4 and 50; press add; verify result is 54
Enter 5 and 50; press add; verify result is 55
Enter -1 and -3; press add; verify result is -4
